entities.title: No relevance ranking and no dependency graph
entities.summary: Results come in path order; there is no relevance ranking and no import or dependency graph.
entities.impact: With many matches, the most useful ones may be on a later page.

entities.title: find_references is name-based
entities.summary: References are identifier occurrences with the exact name, not type-resolved; same-named symbols are not told apart.
entities.impact: A common member name returns uses of every symbol with that name.

entities.title: search does not look inside files over 2 MiB
entities.summary: ScanFile skips any file larger than 2 MiB, including the files over 16 MiB that the prefilter always keeps as candidates.
entities.impact: Matches in large text files are silently missing from search; the answer does not say a file was skipped.
entities.workaround: Use run with grep or rg for large files.

entities.title: The run allowlist is best effort
entities.summary: RunPolicy checks the file name of argv[0] and pattern-matches arguments; it does not confine reads to the root.
entities.impact: An allowed program can read any file the user can (for example cat with an absolute path), and a program at another path with an allowed file name passes the check.
entities.details: The policy's own comment: it guards against agent mistakes, not hostile agents. The README calls it a best-effort guard against edits.

entities.title: view has no size cap and no token budget
entities.summary: ViewTool reads the whole .cs file and returns the whole view; unlike read, search and outline it has no file-size limit, no max_tokens and no paging.
entities.impact: A very large or generated C# file comes back in full, however long, and is parsed with Roslyn on every call.
entities.workaround: Use read with a line range, or outline, for large files.
